milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require the player to locate and observe the target. Oak_log blocks are placed at (2-3, 0-2, 1-2) relative to spawn. The player must navigate near them and face their direction to demonstrate discovery.

Uses inventory_has because mining spruce_log drops the item into the player's inventory. The player must break at least one spruce_log block from the grove at (-2 to 0, 0-2, 3-4) and collect the drop.

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require the player to locate and observe the target. Jungle_log blocks are placed at (5-6, 0-2, 0) relative to spawn. The player must navigate near them and face their direction.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an iron helmet results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player must first craft a crafting table from oak planks (2x2 inventory grid), then use 5 iron ingots in the helmet recipe pattern on the 3x3 crafting table grid.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because building a road requires placing blocks in the road corridor. The task_text specifies jungle planks as the road material. Checks for at least 4 jungle_planks placed in the corridor between shelter and pyramid at (12-16, 0, 12-16).

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') to verify wall construction. The shelter foundation is at (8-12, 0, 8-12). Walls must be built at y=1 to y=3 using oak planks (lower) and spruce planks (upper) as specified in task_text. NO door check here — the door is only verified in the trap milestone to avoid sequencing conflicts where the shelter would be sealed before the creeper can enter. Both plank rules must pass (AND logic).

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require the player to locate and observe the target. The potted_blue_orchid is placed at (9, 0, 13) just south of the shelter foundation. The player must navigate near it and face it to demonstrate discovery.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because lighting up the pyramid requires placing torches on/around the structure at (15-19, 0-3, 15-19). No pre-existing torches in the scene — all must be player-placed from the 16 torches given in inventory. Generous box (14-20, 0-5, 14-20) accounts for torches placed on outer edges.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='mob') to verify the creeper has been pushed from its spawn at (10,1,7) into the shelter interior, AND count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') to verify the door is placed confirming enclosure. The mob detection box (9,0,8)-(11,3,12) deliberately EXCLUDES z=7 (the creeper's spawn position) so this condition is NOT pre-satisfied. The creeper must be pushed at least 1 block south to z>=8. Both rules must pass (AND logic).
